profile.summary:
Dedicated software engineer with an industry demonstrated history of building powerful applications and solving complex technical puzzles. Driven by continuous learning and persistence, I dedicate myself to mastering new materials rapidly so I can deliver immediate, high-quality contributions to my team.
​My technical backbone is built on full-stack development, spanning strong C# (.NET/.NET Core) capabilities, desktop solutions like WPF and WinForms, robust API integrations, and versatile web skills using JavaScript and its various frameworks. I have experience managing both SQL and NoSQL databases, creating custom automation frameworks as well as executing modern testing frameworks, and navigating the complete SDLC using Git, TFS, and top-tier IDEs (Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains).
​Beyond the code, I am an approachable, empathetic communicator who thrives in Agile/Scrum team cultures. I believe in active listening, collaborative problem-solving, and never hesitating to hop on a live meeting to clear up a bottleneck or help a teammate.
